title: PAP Supply Replenishment Program — Resupply Schedules and the Coverage Each One Follows
content:
The PAP Supply Replenishment Program runs six resupply schedules. Each schedule is tied to one payer class of the patient's primary coverage, and an enrollment follows the schedule whose payer class matches that coverage.

## Schedule register

| Schedule | Payer class of the primary coverage it follows | Entry conditions recorded for the schedule |
|---|---|---|
| Medicare Part B Resupply Schedule | Original Medicare Part B | PAP device in use; written order for PAP supplies |
| Medicare Advantage Resupply Schedule | Medicare Advantage HMO or Medicare Advantage PPO | PAP device in use; written order for PAP supplies |
| Medicaid Resupply Schedule | Medicaid Fee-for-Service | PAP device in use; written order for PAP supplies; prior authorization required |
| Commercial HMO Resupply Schedule | Commercial HMO | PAP device in use; written order for PAP supplies |
| Commercial PPO Resupply Schedule | Commercial PPO | PAP device in use; written order for PAP supplies |
| Self-Pay Supply Subscription | no coverage billed | PAP device in use; card on file |

## Notes on the register

- The Medicare Advantage Resupply Schedule is the one schedule that answers to two payer classes: a Medicare Advantage HMO and a Medicare Advantage PPO both lead to it.
- The Self-Pay Supply Subscription is the schedule of a patient for whom no coverage is billed for supplies; its entry conditions name a card on file instead of a written order.
- Only the Medicaid Resupply Schedule lists a prior authorization among its entry conditions.

## Reading the register

**Which schedule does a patient whose primary coverage is a Commercial PPO follow?** The Commercial PPO Resupply Schedule.

**Which schedule does a patient with no coverage billed for supplies follow?** The Self-Pay Supply Subscription.

**Does a Medicare Advantage PPO lead to the Commercial PPO Resupply Schedule?** No. A Medicare Advantage PPO is a Medicare Advantage payer class and leads to the Medicare Advantage Resupply Schedule.
